label: Moral-governance source identity and intellect/will omission test
summary: Tested the #1747 proposed moral governance to source-level intellect and will on one fixed informed easy-rescue case (same actual necessary root n, weak moral-order grounding predicate, agents, obligations, standing and priority). Finite Boolean valuations witness that the weak, uninterpreted GroundsMoralOrder predicate, together with ActualRoot and NecessaryAt, entails neither HasIntellect(n) nor HasWill(n) in that signature; they are not countermodels of a strong authored-law premise; a distinct rational secondary governor g can coexist with impersonal n; knowledge of ends without will is compatible only when q19's existing WillFollowsIntellectReading is withheld; and HasWill plus intentional global ordering does not by itself give recipient-directed WillsGoodFor. Populated positive profile witnesses nonvacuity only for the selected predicate assignments. These are JS-checked structural omission controls, not Lean/Comparator certificates, actual-world models, or refutations of historical rivals. Wielenberg's primitive norms can reject the stronger 'n grounds all authoritative norms' premise instead of satisfying it; actual Darwall standing remains open. Aquinas ST I-II q90 a1 ad3, q91 and q93, and ST I q19 motivate a conditional source-lawgiving/practical-end-adoption route; q93 already assumes divine governance. Reused existing GodHasIntellect and GodHasWill consumers and the delivered modular q19 will result, with no new proof or root-premise status change. Independent semantic challenge accepted the conditional distinction with those explicit qualifications. Detailed connected reconstruction and rival comparison: docs/notes/moral-governance-intellect-will.md. The 2026-11-25 continuation in the linked note, ‘Who can release a promise, and what ends at expiry?’, compares an accepted undertaking for a third party across creditor release, an unauthorized bystander's identical words, and expiry without further action. Under a limited promissory power, the outstanding claim tracks the holder's informed choice before expiry and the original term thereafter. This gives positive warrant for finite parties setting content. Necessary standing principles plus their acts explain the same local verdicts as a power instituted by one wise source. The additional comparison is an analyst argument, outside the earlier reviewed JS control. Stage Two result 60204936 consumes the two universal attribute claims; evidence of one finite act supplies neither universal. The original-authority continuation in docs/notes/moral-governance-intellect-will.md#personal-and-impersonal-source-original-authority-institution-and-operative-purpose-2026-11-25-draft holds prospective extinction fixed under creditor release, automatic lapse, authorized dispensation and authored automatic rule. Only the deliberate dispensation stipulates guidance of the token release by the source’s adopted end. A creditor’s title, standing to confer that title and actual exercise of title remain distinct. This comparison extends the earlier waiver assessment within its stated rule. The independent semantic challenge and targeted recheck accepted the scoped #1983 follow-up at 9789928fc3a1f5eaa932d93bfed5f3f5bce8cbab. A source’s adopted end must guide the token dispensation. The conferral of title, the holding of title and its exercise have distinct conditions.
blocker: The reserved-power comparison grants jurisdiction in the deliberate row. Next compare constitutive title of the first agents with rightful intentional institution at the same actual root, holding their natures, goods and claims fixed. What grounds the authority to confer title and the adopted end’s actual guidance? GOD_4 bearer identity, capacity versus promulgation and the #1459/#1737 interfaces remain open.

current_assessment.scope: A finite promise for a third party, its holder’s release, and the source of jurisdiction in the same necessary being.
current_assessment.assessment: On the stated promissory authority premise, an informed release by the holder changes the duty. The same words spoken by an unauthorized bystander leave it in force. Expiry follows the agreed term without another act. These verdicts favor recognition of the parties’ authority over an account using only the visitor’s benefit. Both finite authority under a general impersonal principle and an authority instituted by a wise source explain the local verdicts.
current_assessment.next_test: For a claimed dispensation while the creditor objects, distinguish the provenance of the directive, the source’s jurisdiction in this case, and evidence that this very source intentionally instituted the general power.
current_assessment.evidence: The independent challenge checked Hart’s printed pages 180 and 183–84, the three cases, the standing premise and the exact Stage Two and will consumers. The final wording retains the difference between release and expiry, and between local jurisdiction and authorship.
current_assessment.supersedes: None. This adds a comparison of voluntary undertakings to the earlier rescue and instrumentality assessments.
